name: ot_qkh_ktree_lkp-lkp1-COMMIT
purpose: Per-lane KPV lockstep K-tree for the KV MU release die heads (OT_KV_KPV_LK=1 -> ot_qkh_head_native_r4_s_lk / _ft_s_lk): closed ot_qkh_ktree + all 16 lane kpv read, lane mismatch = lane fault on the existing g_f path. Replaces the KPV_LOCKSTEP unused-output classification (ROOT HOLD) by a hardware check. Static, +0 cycles.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qkh_ktree_lk u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_ktree_lk.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_subtiles.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_nearhbm_prod.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv physical/ref_tile/ot_qkh_ktree_m5/src/rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/ot_qkh_ktree_lkp/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/ot_qkh_ktree_lkp/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/ot_qkh_ktree_lkp --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qkh_ktree_lk  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: KV-DCAL2 10-19 K.STA.ECTL KPV_LOCKSTEP (ROOT: no blanket lockstep admission, apply misc_b): ot_qkh_ktree_lk = the closed ot_qkh_ktree (ot_qkh_ktree_m5, same RTL + the m5 fastfp snapshot) wrapped so all 16 lane kpv are read: lane mismatch vs lane 0 -> lane fault into the existing gf_r -> g_f path (XOR16 + OR, 2 gate levels before an existing input flop). Same outline 151.2 x 97.2 (die slot unchanged), 15 new N-face pins (544 on 151.2 um = 3.6/um). +0 cycles, +0 flops. lkp: balanced full-face pins (lk1 gate showed PPL-clustered partial-face N pins ~7/um).
